tools.name: hsk_lookup
tools.description: Look up a Chinese word by simplified characters, traditional characters, or pinyin. Returns all pronunciation forms with meanings, frequency rank, and HSK level. Pinyin input accepts tone marks (hǎo), tone numbers (hao3), or plain ASCII (hao). Meanings are in English.

params.name: word
params.description: Chinese word to look up. Accepts simplified (好), traditional (國), or pinyin (hǎo / hao3 / hao).

tools.name: hsk_frequency
tools.description: Get the frequency ranking and usage statistics for a Chinese word. Returns the word's rank among HSK vocabulary (1 = most frequent), raw frequency score, rarity class, and HSK level.

params.name: word
params.description: Simplified Chinese word. Example: '的', '好', '准备'.

tools.name: hsk_convert_script
tools.description: Convert a Chinese word to all 5 transcription systems: pinyin (tone marks), numeric (tone numbers), Wade-Giles, Bopomofo/Zhuyin, and Gwoyeu Romatzyh. Returns all systems for every pronunciation form.

params.name: word
params.description: Simplified Chinese word. Example: '翻译', '好'.

tools.name: hsk_classifier
tools.description: Find the measure word (classifier / 量词) for a Chinese noun. Returns all classifiers associated with the word. Empty list if no classifiers exist in the dataset.

params.name: word
params.description: Simplified Chinese noun. Example: '书', '航班', '猫'.

tools.name: hsk_convert_characters
tools.description: Convert a Chinese word between simplified and traditional characters. Accepts either script and returns both with pinyin and meanings. Covers 11,470 HSK words. Meanings are in English.

params.name: word
params.description: Chinese word in simplified or traditional. Example: '国' or '國'.

tools.name: hsk_search_meaning
tools.description: Search for HSK words by English meaning using full-text search. Each result includes simplified characters, pinyin, all transcription systems, meanings, classifiers, and HSK levels. Ordered by relevance. Paginated (20 per page).

params.name: query
params.description: English meaning to search for. Example: 'recommend', 'beautiful', 'to eat'.

params.name: cursor
params.description: Pagination cursor from a previous response.

tools.name: hsk_words_by_radical
tools.description: Find all HSK words sharing a given radical (部首). Each word includes simplified/traditional characters, pinyin, part of speech, meanings, radical, frequency rank, and HSK levels. Ordered by frequency. Paginated (20 per page).

params.name: cursor
params.description: Pagination cursor from a previous response.

params.name: radical
params.description: Chinese radical character. Example: '女', '口', '心'.

tools.name: hsk_polyphones
tools.description: List Chinese characters with multiple pronunciations (多音字) in HSK vocabulary. Each result includes all pronunciation forms with pinyin, meanings, and part of speech. Ordered by frequency. Paginated (20 per page).

params.name: cursor
params.description: Pagination cursor from a previous response.

tools.name: hsk_homophones
tools.description: Find HSK words sharing the same pinyin pronunciation (homophones). Useful for drilling tone-pair distinctions. Each result includes simplified characters, pinyin, all transcription systems, meanings, and HSK levels. Paginated (20 per page).

params.name: cursor
params.description: Pagination cursor from a previous response.

params.name: pinyin
params.description: Pinyin to search for. Accepts tone marks (yì), tone numbers (yi4), or plain (yi).

tools.name: hsk_build_study_set
tools.description: Build a study set of HSK words for a given level, ordered by frequency (most common first). Each word includes simplified/traditional characters, pinyin, part of speech, meanings, radical, frequency rank, and HSK levels. Paginated (20 per page).

params.name: level
params.description: HSK level. Range: 1-7.

params.name: cursor
params.description: Pagination cursor from a previous response.

params.name: scheme
params.description: HSK scheme. 'new' = HSK 3.0 (levels 1-7), 'old' = HSK 2.0 (levels 1-6). Default: 'new'.

tools.name: hsk_suggest_next
tools.description: Suggest the next words to learn at a given HSK level, excluding words already known. Each word includes simplified/traditional characters, pinyin, part of speech, meanings, radical, frequency rank, and HSK levels. Ordered by frequency (most useful first). Paginated (20 per page).

params.name: known
params.description: Simplified Chinese words the learner already knows. Example: ['你好', '谢谢', '外卖'].

params.name: level
params.description: Target HSK level. Range: 1-7.

params.name: cursor
params.description: Pagination cursor from a previous response.

params.name: scheme
params.description: HSK scheme. 'new' = HSK 3.0 (levels 1-7), 'old' = HSK 2.0 (levels 1-6). Default: 'new'.

tools.name: hsk_compare
tools.description: Compare 2-5 Chinese words side by side. Each word shows simplified/traditional characters, pinyin, part of speech, frequency rank, HSK levels, radical, all transcription systems, and meanings.

params.name: words
params.description: Simplified Chinese words to compare. Example: ['聪明', '推荐', '参考'].

tools.name: hsk_diff
tools.description: Compare two HSK levels to see vocabulary overlap and differences. Shows words exclusive to each level and words shared by both. Useful for comparing old (HSK 2.0) vs new (HSK 3.0) standards.

params.name: level_a
params.description: First HSK level. Range: 1-7.

params.name: level_b
params.description: Second HSK level. Range: 1-7.

params.name: scheme_a
params.description: HSK scheme for level_a. 'new' = HSK 3.0, 'old' = HSK 2.0. Default: 'new'.

params.name: scheme_b
params.description: HSK scheme for level_b. 'new' = HSK 3.0, 'old' = HSK 2.0. Default: 'new'.

prompts.name: hsk-study-session
prompts.description: Start a guided HSK study session. Builds a study set for your level, lets you exclude words you already know, and presents vocabulary as a structured table.

prompts.name: hsk-word-deep-dive
prompts.description: Get comprehensive details about a Chinese word: all transcription systems, frequency rank, part of speech, classifiers, and homophones.
